# mvstmt: exercise hasBreak with various node types in for body
mv F:/BEGIN/+0,/END/-0 New
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x int, ch chan int, items []int, v any) {
	// BEGIN
	for {
		if x > 0 {
			break
		}
		for i := 0; i < x; i++ {
			break
		}
		for _, item := range items {
			_ = item
			break
		}
		select {
		case <-ch:
			break
		}
		switch x {
		case 0:
			break
		}
		switch v.(type) {
		case int:
			break
		}
	}
	// END
}
